nom: Elizabeth Arden Retinol + HPR Ceramide Capsules Rapid Skin Renewing Serum

segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin, including one who called it a holy grail for winter dryness, report it keeps skin soft, moisturized, and glowy without being sticky or oily.
segments.sensitive: Reviewers with sensitive skin mostly report no irritation, redness, or breakouts, though one reviewer described purging and irritation on the forehead and around the mouth from the product's strength.
segments.mature: Older reviewers, including a 76-year-old long-time user and one who bought it for her mother's mature skin, report a smoother, younger-looking complexion.

concerns.aging: Reviewers focused on fine lines and firmness report visibly plumper, smoother skin and reduced wrinkles with consistent use, including when applied to the neck.
concerns.dehydration: Reviewers dealing with dryness describe the serum as deeply hydrating, keeping skin soft and moisturized through winter without a greasy or oily after-feel.
concerns.redness: Most reviewers report no redness or irritation, and some say it calmed irritation left by retinA treatment; one reviewer had a severe reaction with facial swelling and puffiness under the eyes, and another experienced irritation and purging around the mouth and forehead.
concerns.barrier: A few reviewers credit the ceramide and peptide formula with repairing and strengthening the skin barrier alongside anti-aging benefits.
concerns.blemishes: Most reviewers report no new breakouts, though one reviewer with sensitive skin experienced purging on the forehead and around the mouth.

extraits.texte: I got this for free as a Bday gift at Ulta. I used this and it caused a horrible puffiness on my face and swelling under my eyes. I have never had a reaction to using any product. After several days my face puffiness went down but the lines under my eyes remain. It has added about 15 years to my face. I am devastated.

I received this product in exchange for my honest review. I love the packaging and the individual capsules help me to use the right amount and feel very luxurious. The texture is thick enough to spread, but it is a little difficult to get it all out of the capsule. My only complaint is that my skin seemed to be too sensitive for the strength of this product and I had some irritation and purging on my forehead and around my mouth.

Super awesome product would definitely recommend this. Very effectiveness on my dry skin. The dosage I use is one capsule in the morning and one capsule before bed depending upon how dry my skin is. I store it in my bathroom cupboard where it is cool and dry. Very oily at first until my skin soaks all it's goodness up than it leaves my skin glowing. Awesome! Awesome! Awesome!

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] I wish I had a full body version of this. I suffer from horrible dry skin in the winter. Even with maintaining my moisturizers and serums and all of the things my skin hates the dry winter air but not this year. I used this through the winter and it kept my skin soft, moisturized, and glowy without being sticky or oily. The product had no noticeable scent and each bead contained the perfect amount of product. I was really concerned that it wasn't going to be enough (dry skin usually soaks up all the products) but it was the perfect amount every time. The bottle and packaging felt very high end and I loved that the bottle was a 1/4 turn to open vs a standard screw top. When my hands were already damp from other products or washing my face I never had an issue opening it. Also my husband was able to open it easily while he was having an arthritis flare.

[I received this product in exchange for my honest review] Each biodegradable capsule contains the perfect dose of product for my face and neck. The serum itself has an ultra silky texture. It does take some time to fully absorb, but I am ultimately left with super soft, deeply hydrated skin. Ceramides and peptides help nourish and strengthen my natural skin barrier for noticeable anti-aging benefits.

Omg. These are so good for mature skin.. I gave these to my mom and she loved them. The scent is amazing, they are so easy to use! I like the fact you have to break it open yourself, absorbs right into the skin and leaves you so glowy.

extraits.titre: This is the best product ever.
extraits.texte: [I received this product in exchange for my honest review] This stuff is amazing. Leaves my skin clear and soft. But also tight. Easy to use and apply. Easy directions. Does not cause me irritation and my skin is sensitive.
